text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there something I can do for Yukino Bijin...?
Before I knew it, my hands were already drafting a training regimen for her.
choice_data_list: Wait, what am I doing when I haven't even been asked...?

text_block_list.text: E-Excuse meee~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Thank goodness, I got the right room!
Sorry for botherin' you when you're so busy.
choice_data_list: You're...!
You're...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wanted to thank you for yesterday...!
Here, please take this! I hope it suits your taste...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the paper bag she handed me was a box of rice crackers in a tasteful package.
It read: "Morioka Specialty Confection."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're workin' right now, so please have some during your break...
Wait, huh? What's that? "For Yukino Bijin"...?
choice_data_list: Ah, well, I kind of put this together...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*...! Wh-What in the world...!
A training plan just for me...?!
choice_data_list: Would you like to take a look...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, please! I'd love to know all about it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, mm-hmm, so there's training methods like this...!
It's truly easy to understand, super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The Central League really is cutting edge with training too, huh!
Back when I ran in my local club, we never did anything like this.
choice_data_list: Your hometown was Morioka, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was born in a tiny village in Morioka.
Surrounded by nature, everyone's so kind... it's a truly wonderful place!
choice_data_list: I'd love to hear more about your hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shucks! There ain't nothing interesting to tell, honest!
Though... ehehe, well, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Where I'm from, the winters are real harsh, and every year we get beautiful snow.
In the dead of winter, everything as far as the eye can see turns completely white.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Did you know? Snow absorbs sound, so when it piles up,
it gets truly, utterly silent all around.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I'd run through that pure white world with nothing but my own footsteps,
it felt like I could go anywhere... and that's how I fell in love with running.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Then, I started running in the local kids' club.
Everyone was so happy, cheering, "You're so fast, so fast!"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Go win in the Central League someday!" The whole village entrusted their dreams
to me. And little by little, I really started believing I could.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I was just daydreaming with vague longing, spinning my wheels...
And that's when... my childhood friend gave me a push!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My fuzzy dream took a clear shape as a "City Girl"
all thanks to that friend.
choice_data_list: They must mean a lot to you.
They must mean a lot to you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And so that I can show them how proud I've become...
I wanna get stronger. I wanna win fair and square...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Honestly speaking, what do you think of my skills right now...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze was dead serious... She wanted an unvarnished opinion.
I wanted to answer her feelings with complete sincerity.
choice_data_list: You've still got a lot of training ahead of you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe... Is that right!
Thank you kindly for telling me the honest truth.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm happier when someone's straight with me like this.
Becoming popular just on hype ain't the kind of "City Girl" I'm aiming to be.
choice_data_list: "City Girl", huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had already come to understand that this word
meant far more to her than just a 'stylish girl from the metropolis'...
choice_data_list: What is a City Girl in your eyes?
What is a City Girl in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gah...! Well, um, a "City Girl" is, like...
How do I put it, they're just completely amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They're sparklin', stylish, and cool, but that ain't all!
They've got a strong will, real talent, and... *Mmmph*, geez!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It'd be faster to just show you!
Let's go see a real, wonderful "City Girl" right now!
choice_data_list: Right now?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I was brought all the way to Nakayama Racecourse.
The one running in today's race was...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Hey, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*! Did you see that?!
She's truly, truly cool! Such a stylish glance...!
choice_data_list: That girl is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's City-san! Out of all the "City Girls",
she's an exceptionally sparklin' Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... she's the one who was in that magazine I saw before coming to Tokyo.
Ehehe, we were both surprised when we found out after becoming friends!
choice_data_list: She's your inspiration, then.
She's your inspiration, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Gold City put on a magnificent run.
Her sheer ability rivaled even her striking beauty...!
choice_data_list: (So this is a true "City Girl"...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—That was incredible, wasn't it?
The whole crowd went, "*Whoooa!*"...!
choice_data_list: It really was amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right? A "City Girl" has beauty, strength, and heart—
she has it all! I wanna be just like that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Only then do I think I could truly be the 'Star of Morioka.'
Not just a passing fad—I gotta be an Umamusume folks genuinely wanna cheer for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san and Inari-san became 'Stars' because of how strong they are.
City-san too...! I wanna be like them...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Though... right now, people are only making a fuss over me 'cause a country bumpkin trying hard is amusing...
I haven't shown any real strength yet.
choice_data_list: You can show them your strength from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-You think I've got strength worth showing?
Someone like me...?
choice_data_list: Of course! I haven't forgotten how you ran last night.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin walked alongside me in silence, lost in thought...
Then, out of the blue, she spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're a lot like the folks back home.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just like everyone back in my village, you look at me for who I am and believe in me.
I can tell that you're truly cheerin' for me from the bottom of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Will stickin' to this routine get me closer to bein' a "city girl"?
choice_data_list: Without a doubt, it definitely will!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! The truth is, my debut race is comin' up real soon.
I was thinkin' that if I can prove what I'm made of there, maybe somethin' will change.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So until then... well,
would you mind keepin' an eye on my trainin'?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just until the race is fine! I want you to whip me into
top shape! P-Please, I'm beggin' you...!
choice_data_list: I'd be glad to...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! Thank you so much, gansu!
I-I might be a bit rough around the edges, but I'll be in your care, gansu!
